dct_description_sm: The higher the concentration of people in an ecoprovince, the higher the chance of loss of habitat and species. To better evaluate and minimize population impacts on the environment, it is necessary to study the distribution and variation of population within ecological areas. The map shows the population variation by eco-province, between 1971 and 1996.
dct_title_s: Threats to Ecosystems - Population Variation by Ecoprovince, 1971 to 1996
